descriptionChirho: Spatial adverbial sense indicating motion or position toward the rear, translated as backward, back, or behind.
Temporal extension of the spatial sense, referring to what comes after in time: the future or the end.
Geographic sense where behind (facing east) denotes the west, used for cardinal direction.
The rear part or hindquarters of animals, used as a concrete anatomical noun with pronominal suffixes.
The back or rear part of a person or object, used as a concrete noun often with possessive suffixes.
